item.text: The docs confirm 50-order pagination, short-lived bearer tokens, and per-customer discount/region records. I’m now traversing every page and will retry transient failures using the server’s stated delay.

The full traversal completed: 30/30 pages, 1,500 listings, and 20 repeated listings discarded, leaving 1,480 distinct orders. The service did trigger both rate limits and token expiry; those requests were retried successfully. I’m writing the two required files and running final structural and arithmetic checks now.
